#rag-toolkit

rag-toolkit is a small collection of utilities for running retrieval experiments. It ships loaders, chunkers, an evaluation harness and adapters for common vector databases so that you can compare configurations quickly.

Install

npm install rag-toolkit

After installing, create an index from a folder of Markdown files and run the evaluation harness against your question set to measure recall at k and mean reciprocal rank.
